clauses.clause: a closed state exists
clauses.measured: S_CLOSED_RETAINED and S_CLOSED_RELEASED are realized configurations

clauses.clause: an open state exists
clauses.measured: S_OPEN is realized

clauses.clause: a motion connects them in both directions
clauses.measured: three segments traversed - M1_UNLOCK, M2_WITHDRAW, M3_OPEN - over 250 samples in total, max common volume 0.000e+00 mm^3
clauses.reversibility: each segment is a one-parameter family of rigid transforms; traversal in the reverse direction visits the same configurations

clauses.clause: each participating body carries engagement geometry
clauses.measured: the closure runs in channels realized on the enclosure: INT-01 0.2000, INT-02 0.2000, INT-05 0.2000, INT-06 0.2000 mm; seats measured at INT-03 and INT-04

clauses.clause: guidance or support present where the concept depends on it
clauses.measured: the concept is a captive prismatic closure: it depends on the two ledges (INT-03, INT-04), the two depth faces (INT-01, INT-02) and the two lips (INT-05, INT-06). All six measured as declared, and the captivity probe confirms the closure cannot be lifted out at slide [0.0, 10.0, 40.0, 70.0] mm.

clauses.clause: a closure detached in the open state is admissible
clauses.measured: LIM-01 declares the closure liftable at full open, where the lips are relieved for installation. The invariant's own exclusion says a permanent connection is not required.

clauses.clause: every declared intended interaction is physically coherent
clauses.measured: 13 declared interactions, all measured inside their declared regions

clauses.clause: in the open state the closure does not obstruct the declared usable access
clauses.measured: intruding volume into the declared access region at S_OPEN: {'BODY-CAM': 0.0, 'BODY-COVER': 0.0, 'BODY-ENCLOSURE': 0.0}. The same region is covered by 21367 mm^3 of closure when closed, so it is a region the closure genuinely controls rather than one drawn where the closure never reaches.

clauses.clause: along the transition, no volume shared outside declared interaction regions
clauses.measured: max common volume over all pairs and all samples of all three segments: 0.000e+00 mm^3 (threshold 1.0e-06)

invariants.notes: The access region is 84 of the 90 mm aperture. That shortfall is a property of a captive slide, is declared in manifest.yaml, and a reviewer is entitled to judge it insufficient - which would be a finding about the design, not about the measurement.

clauses.clause: material content conserved across states
clauses.measured: per-body volume identical across all three states to within 1e-6 mm^3

clauses.clause: no body's extent altered to achieve clearance
clauses.measured: all three bodies are rigid; every state is a rigid transform of the as-built solid, so no shape change is possible by construction

clauses.clause: the design declares a discrete terminal open pose
clauses.measured: poses.yaml terminal_conditions, kind DISCRETE_TERMINAL_POSE

clauses.clause: that pose is produced by a realized physical condition, not a model limit
clauses.measured: INT-08 face pair in contact at 84 mm of travel (min distance 0.000000 mm); common volume <= 1.0e-06 mm^3 at every probed slide within the bounds and > 0 immediately outside them at BOTH ends

invariants.notes: Both bounds are end-wall faces on the enclosure, not numbers imposed on the model. The closed bound INT-07 is realized the same way.

clauses.clause: holds the closure in the closed state against the declared disturbance
clauses.measured: the design declares no disturbance magnitude, so the predicate has no quantity to apply, and this toolchain computes no forces. What IS measured: the slide is geometrically blocked by the cam shaft beyond 0.25 mm of free play, and the quarter-turned blade blocks the cam's own withdrawal (capture_holds=True).

clauses.clause: released by a deliberate user action
clauses.measured: ordered release: quarter turn, then lift, then set aside. Aligning the blade opens the capture (capture_opens_on_quarter_turn=True) and with the cam withdrawn the full 84.0 mm travel is free (slide_free=True).

clauses.clause: engagement localized on both participating bodies
clauses.measured: all three bodies carry material in the declared engagement region; the cam spans the closure bore and the enclosure keyway

invariants.notes: Two clauses PASS on measurement, and the blocking probe shows the retention geometrically prevents both the slide and its own removal. The invariant as a whole still cannot be discharged, because its first clause needs a quantity the design does not declare. NOT_EVALUABLE is not FAIL.

clauses.clause: close-engage, release, close-engage-again completes
clauses.measured: five-configuration cycle traversed; engaged at start and at end

clauses.clause: every participating feature retains the geometry its role depends on
clauses.measured: all three body volumes identical at cycle start and end to 1e-6 mm^3

clauses.clause: no feature consumed or permanently disabled by one cycle
clauses.measured: rigid bodies under rigid transforms; no geometry is modified

clauses.clause: durability over a cycle count
clauses.reason: no cycle count is stated and wear is not modelled

clauses.clause: a realized access path reaches the actuation feature
clauses.measured: a 60 mm cylinder of radius 13.0 mm rising from the knob top face is clear of the enclosure and the closure in the retained state

invariants.notes: The actuation is a rotation. What is checked is that the knob can be reached and gripped from outside; the effort required to turn it is NOT_VERIFIED.

clauses.clause: an interior cavity exists
clauses.measured: free interior volume 383955.9 mm^3

clauses.clause: reachable through the aperture in the open state
clauses.measured: the declared access prism is unobstructed at S_OPEN

invariants.notes: The invariant's exclusion says cavity shape, volume and aperture size are unconstrained, so the partial uncovering does not bear on this clause.

clauses.clause: each discrete part reaches its assembled position without passing through already-placed material
clauses.measured: 2 insertion steps swept; max common volume 0.000e+00 mm^3

clauses.clause: parts formed together or permanently joined declare that
clauses.measured: all three bodies are installed_as DISCRETE; none is co-formed or permanently joined

invariants.notes: The lips are relieved over the loading zone precisely so an insertion path exists: a lipped channel closed at both ends cannot be entered by any translation. Two steps are operations along paths validated in step 5 and are marked as not swept again.

clauses.clause: for each interface that carries load, a path exists to a reaction site
clauses.measured: every body is connected to BODY-ENCLOSURE through declared load-bearing interfaces: BODY-CAM, BODY-COVER, BODY-ENCLOSURE

clauses.clause: adequacy of the path for a given magnitude
clauses.reason: quantitative; held at UNR-BM-001-001. The invariant's own exclusion says existence is structural and sufficiency is not required here.

clauses.clause: the criterion rests on direct causal evidence (HSD-006 branch A)
clauses.measured: the feature's geometry exists (INT-08 declared and measured at 0.000000 mm); contact occurs at the relevant configuration; and the behaviour is caused by it - common volume is 0 at every probed slide inside the bounds and positive immediately outside them

clauses.clause: branch B discriminating evidence
clauses.reason: branch A and branch B are alternatives, not a sequence. A control is not mandatory once branch A is satisfied. Producing one would require a variant model with an end wall removed, which this run does not create.

clauses.clause: no force window is cited as an achieved retention property
clauses.measured: keyword scan over the five authored contract files returned 0 candidate lines. No force or torque value is asserted as an outcome anywhere in this reference.

invariants.notes: Satisfied vacuously. Note that this reference has a cam, whose usefulness depends on a torque nobody has computed; that is recorded as NOT_VERIFIED rather than quietly claimed.

name: Oracle predicate evaluation
scope_warning: These are GEOMETRIC and KINEMATIC results. They do not establish that the rank-1 source is satisfied. Cam holding torque, friction, wear, effort, strength, manufacturing cost, disturbance capacity and durability are all NOT_VERIFIED.

status_vocabulary.NOT_EVALUABLE: the design does not record what the predicate needs
status_vocabulary.NOT_VERIFIED: no evidence of adequate fidelity exists

actuator_access.note: BODY-CAM is excluded: the path terminates AT the knob, so the knob occupying its own start is not an obstruction.

captivity.note: Captive everywhere except at full open, which is what LIM-01 declares and what makes vertical installation possible. NRM-BM-001-002 explicitly does not require a permanent connection.

cavity.method: cavity prism minus the enclosure solid

cycle.note: geometric repeatability only; wear and cycle count are not modelled

force_window_scan.note: Matches are inspected. A line recording that a quantity is NOT verified is not a citation of an achieved property.

declared_region.honesty_note: a captive sliding closure cannot uncover the whole of its own aperture; see manifest.yaml declared_usable_access
declared_region.what: the part of the aperture open in the open state, between the ledges, extruded 100 mm upward

blocking_probe.free_play_note: The slide block does not begin at zero. INT-09 and INT-10 are 0.1 and 0.2 running clearances, so the shaft has to take them up before it bears. The measured onset is the free play those clearances imply. A retention with zero play would need an interference fit, which this reference deliberately does not use.
blocking_probe.what_this_does_not_show: any holding capacity, cam torque, friction or wear
blocking_probe.what_this_shows: The shaft blocks the slide beyond the free play; the quarter-turned blade blocks the cam's own withdrawal; aligning the blade releases it; and with the cam removed the full travel is free.

retention.release_action: quarter turn of BODY-CAM through 90 deg, then lift 20.0 mm, then set aside; deliberate, ordered, reversible
